vLLM vs TensorRT-LLM: Which Architecture Actually Scales in Production? ⚡

• Throughput: vLLM excels with PagedAttention, TensorRT-LLM offers optimized kernels.
• Latency: TensorRT-LLM often shows lower latency for single requests, vLLM better for batching.
• Consistency: TensorRT-LLM can be more predictable with static batching, vLLM adapts dynamically.
• Failure Modes: Consider memory management and kernel compatibility for each.
• Operational Overhead: TensorRT-LLM requires more model compilation, vLLM is more flexible.

Recommendation: For dynamic, high-throughput production loads, vLLM often leads. For latency-sensitive, predictable workloads, TensorRT-LLM shines.
